observations.finding: Compile failure deletes its shader; successful linking marks both shaders for deletion, while the program owns attached execution resources.
Construction failure loses the owned context and collapses the canvas. This is static error-path inspection, not an injected failure runtime test.
Idempotent destroy deletes textures, buffer and program and loses its owned WebGL2 context.
Instrumentation stores weak references, tracks cumulative creation separately from live wrappers, and labels active only when no explicit delete/lost mark exists.

Each retained sample follows two real HeapProfiler.collectGarbage calls. Current intended schedule is six-family warmup, ten identical returns and324 mixed rebuilds before returning to the same baseline.
